# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes.

## Known limitation

The robot's BLE UART service has no pairing or authentication, so any phone in range can connect and send motion commands. This is part of the thesis design and is documented in the README. Reports about it are welcome, but please do not report it as a new vulnerability.

## Report a vulnerability

Do not report security problems in public issues, discussions, or pull requests.

Report them privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/andrew-abdelmalak/smart-cleaning-robot/security/advisories/new).

Include:

- The affected release or commit
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- The impact you expect

## What happens next

I will reply in the private advisory thread. This is a personal project maintained in my spare time, so I cannot promise a response time.
